vibe: Reassuring, premium, highly secure, deeply anonymous. Awwwards-level craft with an emphasis on emotional safety and trust.

typography.instructions: Use font-light for main hero headings to feel soft and unthreatening. Avoid aggressive bolding except for small uppercase labels.

background.description: A very soft, deep mesh gradient of navy-blue and green. The dark base ensures the user feels 'hidden' and safe, while the green implies healing and balance.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Crystal Glass' variant. Containers should be bg-white/5 with backdrop-blur-2xl and a delicate border-white/10 to separate them from the dark gradient background.
visual_enhancers.rounding: CRITICAL: The user specifically requested highly stylized rounded text boxes. All inputs, textareas, and select triggers MUST use rounded-3xl or rounded-full with deep internal padding (e.g., px-6 py-4).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows to lift the glass cards off the background: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)].
visual_enhancers.glows: Active inputs and focused elements should have a very soft, diffuse mint-green glow: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#34D399]/30 focus:bg-white/10.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for containers. The form should not feel cramped; space implies clarity and calmness.
layouts.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-[80vh]) centered flex column, focusing entirely on the reassuring headline.
layouts.form_wizard: A centered, narrow column (max-w-2xl) to keep focus intimate and reduced cognitive load.
layouts.review_dashboard: Mode B: High Density Bento Grid. Keep reports highly scannable with clear status indicators.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters in a staggered horizontal/vertical layout, deeply padded, revealing on scroll.

motion.scrolling: Implement Lenis for smooth, premium momentum scrolling.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero: The main headline 'Você está seguro aqui.' must use a Framer Motion line-by-line or word-by-word masked reveal. It should feel slow and deliberate.
motion.form_transitions: When moving from Step 1 to Step 2, the previous step should fade out and slide up, and the new step should slide in from the bottom. Do NOT just snap instantly.
motion.micro_interactions: Inputs should smoothly transition their background color and border on focus. Buttons should have a subtle scale down (scale-95) on press.

inputs_and_textareas.style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white placeholder-white/30 backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#34D399] text-[#042F2E] font-medium px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#10B981] transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white font-medium px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white/20 transition-all border border-white/5

dynamic_list.description: For the 'Accused' list in Step 2. Each added person should appear as a highly rounded 'pill' or inline card. The role dropdown and conditional 'Turma' input must be elegantly integrated inline.

protocol_display.style: Massive text (text-5xl sm:text-7xl), tracking-[0.3em], font-mono, glowing softly. Center stage with a prominent 'Copy to Clipboard' interaction.

hero_background_texture.description: Dark teal wavy shapes on black. Use this as a very low opacity (10-20%) background or mask for the hero section to provide an abstract, premium, calming texture.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Do not use heavy 3D that could distract from the serious nature of the tool. Use soft CSS mesh gradients and subtle Framer Motion parallax for the background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the dark gradient passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus_states: Every stylized input MUST have an unmistakable focus ring for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.screen_readers: Use aria-labels for the dynamic add/remove accused buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The tech stack uses standard .js files, NOT .tsx. Provide React code in .js format.
CRITICAL: The background MUST be a soft gradient of green and navy-blue. Implement this using Tailwind bg-gradient or a custom CSS radial mesh gradient on the body or main wrapper.
CRITICAL: The text inputs MUST be heavily rounded (rounded-3xl or rounded-full) and stylized with glassmorphism as per the user's explicit request.
The app has three main flows: Form Step 1, Form Step 2, Protocol Generation, and a separate Review/Admin Dashboard.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use Framer Motion for the Kinetic Hero text reveal and form step transitions.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus (Select Content); they must have a solid or heavily blurred background to remain readable.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients, except for background mesh gradients where it's specifically requested.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
